2) Confirm the exact legal entity name for the vendor record we should create (full name as it should appear on the 1099 / supplier view).
3) Please confirm the ACH routing+acct last4 we should display in the portal (we'll keep full details masked).

Next steps from our side once we have the above:
- I'll upload your W‑9 to the vendor record and kick the micro‑deposit (if you pick that).
- Jordan (cc'd) will map the PO prefix LN- to the vendor profile so our AP system picks it up automatically.
- We'll post a DocuSign link for any required banking authorization if our payment operations team needs it for wires.

I've attached our vendor onboarding checklist and the portal URL so you can confirm fields: https://redwoodapp.example.com/vendors/PROV-4821

Attachments: [Attachment: Vendor_Onboard_Checklist.pdf (pdf)]

If micro‑deposits work, we aim to send them within 24 business hours and you should see two small deposits in your account (usually under $1).

Thanks — feel free to reply inline with the legal name + ACH last4 and your preferred verification method.
